items.title: Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
items.en_title: Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
items.en_oneliner: This release lets agents work directly on sites without APIs and sign in themselves, while background subagents handle long-running tasks.

items.title: “Does Meta think we can’t read?” Meta abandons sketchy commercial terms update.
items.en_title: “Does Meta think we can’t read?” Meta abandons sketchy commercial terms update.
items.en_oneliner: Meta dropped its planned terms change, so Facebook page owners will no longer be forced to let their linked content be used for AI training.

items.title: Quoting Nilay Patel
items.en_oneliner: Quoting Nilay Patel's view that AI products are not yet good enough to justify the costs users are asked to bear.
